solves.reason: (A) arranged differently가 자연스러움. identical+differently는 의미 모순. (B) expensive: 비싼 옷. (C) reluctant: 바꾸기를 꺼림.
(A) wealthy enough to buy: 부유한. (B) rarely dressed themselves: 거의 직접 입지 않음. (C) differ: 다를 수 있다.
(A) located on: 위치해 있다. (B) fasten the buttons: 잠그다. (C) placement: 배치.
③ impoverished(가난한)+enough to buy(살 만큼)=모순. 원문은 wealthy.
③ unfasten(풀다)은 fasten(잠그다)의 반대. 잠그기 쉽게가 맞음.
④ harder(더 어렵게)는 easier의 반대. 쉽게 만들었다가 맞음.
a _____ that began + well-known _____ = tradition. 마지막 문장과 대응.
still _____ to change = reluctant(꺼리는). eager/determined/prepared는 적극적.
to _____ the buttons by putting them = fasten(채우다).
noticed=알아챘다. observed=관찰했다=동의어.
wealthy=부유한. affluent=풍요로운=동의어.
reluctant=꺼리는. hesitant=주저하는=동의어.
rarely=거의~않는. frequently=자주=반의어.
well-known=유명한. obscure=무명의=반의어. celebrated/renowned/prominent=동의어.
(A) is located=situated(위치한). (B) located the document=found(찾아냄).
to attach or close firmly=fasten.
are _____ (locate) = 수동태 be+p.p. = located.
were _____ (usual) right-handed = 부사 usually.
most people _____ = dress themselves. 과거 하녀 vs 현재 자기 자신.
putting them on _____ = the wearer's left-hand side. 오른손잡이 하녀 기준 왼쪽.
